en-US.longDescription:
If you are a designer using many fonts, nexusfont is a must have application.
You can manage/compare/choose fonts with well organized features.
You don't need to install all fonts to the system. You can load fonts you are working with only.
It's simple and easy!
en-US.name: nexusfont

zh-CN.description: 最佳的 Windows 字体管理器
zh-CN.longDescription:
如果你是经常使用多种字体的设计师，nexusfont 是一款必备的应用程序。
你可以通过其条理清晰的功能来管理、比较和选择字体。
无需将所有字体安装到系统中，只需加载你正在使用的字体即可。
简单又方便！
